author: CBR
description:
Spider-Noir is getting two versions: a full color cut and a black-and-white noir cut, and Nicolas Cage personally pushed Prime Video to release it that way. 

In this Short, we explain how the Spider-Noir black-and-white version fits the 1930s/1940s film noir detective tone, and why Cage says he’s playing the character as “70% Humphrey Bogart, 30% Bugs Bunny.”

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 18.
